jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, including ownership of production data systems Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience writing maintainable, tested production code Deep experience designing and operating ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and distributed data-processing systems 5+ years of professional experience building and owning production systems Tuned real Spark jobs for performance and cost on TB-scale or billions of rows in production (skew, shuffle, partitioning, memory, spill) Strong Python and SQL with maintainable, tested production code

jobs.title: AI Full Stack Engineer (Pulse)
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years as a Full Stack Engineer building and maintaining production systems Production-grade experience with LLM application patterns: agents, orchestration frameworks, and RAG Strong backend and data foundations, including APIs, real-time and event-driven services, and high-scale distributed data pipelines in Python with Spark (or comparable frameworks)

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Requires 1+ years of experience. 1-3 years of experience in product, data, analytics, or another highly analytical role Strong analytical skills including Python and SQL Ability to explore datasets, inspect schemas, and test assumptions hands-on
